name: saldu-monorepo
description: Monorepo de gestão financeira pessoal - Saldu

scripts.clean:all: concurrently "npm run clean:api" "npm run clean:web" "npm run clean:e2e"
scripts.dev:web:test: cd apps/web && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.format:all: concurrently "npm run format:api" "npm run format:web" "npm run format:e2e"
scripts.install:all: npm install && concurrently "npm run install:web" "npm run install:e2e"
scripts.test:e2e:ci: cross-env NODE_ENV=test concurrently "npm run dev:api:test" "npm run dev:web:test"
scripts.test:e2e:run:ci: concurrently "npm run test:e2e:ci" "npm run wait && npm run test:e2e" --kill-others --success first
scripts.test:e2e:run:coverage: concurrently "npm run test:e2e:up" "npm run wait && npm run test:e2e:coverage" --kill-others --success first
scripts.test:e2e:run:ui: concurrently "npm run test:e2e:up" "npm run wait && npm run test:e2e:ui" --kill-others --success first
scripts.test:e2e:run: concurrently "npm run test:e2e:up" "npm run wait && npm run test:e2e" --kill-others --success first
scripts.test:e2e:up: cross-env NODE_ENV=test concurrently "npm run dev:api:test" "npm run dev:web"
